name: Bench Press (Barbell)
description: Lie on a flat bench, grip slightly wider than shoulders, lower the bar to mid-chest and press to lockout. The classic horizontal pressing strength builder.

name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
description: Flat-bench press with independent dumbbells for a longer range of motion and balanced side-to-side strength.

name: Incline Press (Barbell)
description: Press on a 30-45° incline bench to emphasize the upper chest and front delts.

name: Incline Press (Dumbbell)
description: Incline pressing with dumbbells; deeper stretch at the bottom and more upper-chest focus.

name: Decline Press (Barbell)
description: Pressing on a slight decline shifts load to the lower chest with reduced shoulder strain.

name: Machine Chest Press
description: Guided pressing path lets you push near failure safely without a spotter.

name: Push-Up
description: Bodyweight horizontal press; elevate the feet or add a plate on the back to progress.

name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
description: Arc the dumbbells with a slight elbow bend to isolate and stretch the pecs.

name: Cable Fly
description: Constant-tension fly; set the pulleys high, mid or low to bias different chest regions.

name: Pec Deck
description: Machine fly with a fixed arc; simple and very effective chest isolation.

name: Dips (Chest)
description: Lean forward on parallel bars and lower deep to load the lower chest; add weight with a belt.

name: Deadlift (Barbell)
description: Hip-hinge the bar from the floor to lockout. The heaviest full-body pull; keep the spine neutral.

name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
description: From standing, push the hips back with soft knees until the hamstrings stretch, then drive back up.

name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
description: Dumbbell hip hinge; great hamstring stretch with easier setup than the barbell version.

name: Pull-Up
description: Overhand-grip vertical pull from a dead hang until the chin clears the bar. The upper-body pull standard.

name: Chin-Up
description: Underhand-grip pull-up variation with more biceps involvement.

name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
description: Seated vertical pull to the upper chest; the scalable stand-in for pull-ups.

name: Seated Row (Cable)
description: Horizontal cable row to the waist; squeeze the shoulder blades together on every rep.

name: Bent-Over Row (Barbell)
description: Hinge to ~45° and row the bar to the lower ribs; a heavy mid-back and lat builder.

name: One-Arm Row (Dumbbell)
description: Row a dumbbell with one knee braced on a bench; strict, spine-friendly unilateral pull.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Chest-supported or landmine row with neutral grip; lets you load the mid-back heavily.

name: Machine Row
description: Chest-supported machine row; removes lower-back fatigue from the equation.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown (Cable)
description: With straight arms, sweep the bar from overhead to the thighs to isolate the lats.

name: Hyperextension
description: Back-extension on a 45° bench; hinge at the hips and squeeze the glutes to rise.

name: Rack Pull (Barbell)
description: Partial deadlift from knee height; overload the top of the pull and the traps.

name: Shrug (Barbell)
description: Elevate the shoulders straight up while holding the bar to build the upper traps.

name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
description: Dumbbell shrugs allow a natural arm path and longer hold at the top.

name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
description: Standing strict press from the collarbone to overhead lockout. The shoulder strength lift.

name: Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
description: Seated or standing dumbbell press; a freer path that is kinder to the shoulders.

name: Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
description: Rotate the palms from facing you to facing forward while pressing, sweeping all three delt heads.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
description: Guided overhead press for safe pressing close to failure.

name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
description: Raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height with soft elbows; the side-delt width builder.

name: Lateral Raise (Cable)
description: Cable lateral raise keeps tension on the side delt through the whole arc.

name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
description: Raise the weight to eye level in front of you to target the anterior delts.

name: Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
description: Hinged reverse fly; move the weight out wide to hit the rear delts.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
description: Machine reverse fly for rear delts with zero lower-back load.

name: Face Pull (Cable)
description: Pull a rope to your face with elbows high and rotate out; rear delts plus rotator-cuff health.

name: Upright Row (Barbell)
description: Pull the bar up along the body to chest height; keep it moderate to spare the shoulders.

name: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
description: Strict standing curl with a straight or EZ bar; the basic mass move for biceps.

name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
description: Alternating or simultaneous curls with supination for a full biceps contraction.

name: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
description: Neutral-grip curl that loads the brachialis and thickens the arm.

name: Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
description: Curl while lying back on an incline bench; big stretch on the long head.

name: Preacher Curl
description: Arms braced on the preacher pad remove momentum for strict biceps work.

name: Cable Curl
description: Constant-tension curl from a low pulley; great as a finisher.

name: Concentration Curl
description: Seated single-arm curl braced against the thigh; pure peak contraction work.

name: Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
description: Press the bar or rope down to lockout keeping elbows pinned; the staple triceps isolation.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
description: Extend the rope overhead to stretch and load the long head of the triceps.

name: Skullcrusher (EZ-Bar)
description: Lying extension lowering the bar to the forehead; keep elbows tucked.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: Bench press with hands at shoulder width; a heavy compound for the triceps.

name: Dips (Triceps)
description: Upright torso dips with elbows close; press to full lockout for the triceps.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
description: Two-hand overhead extension with a single dumbbell; deep long-head stretch.

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: Push-up with hands together under the chest; bodyweight triceps overload.

name: Squat (Barbell)
description: High-bar back squat to at least parallel; the king of lower-body lifts.

name: Front Squat (Barbell)
description: Bar racked on the front delts keeps the torso upright and hammers the quads.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Squat holding a dumbbell at the chest; ideal for form practice and warm-ups.

name: Leg Press
description: Press the sled through a full range without spinal load; foot position shifts the emphasis.

name: Hack Squat (Machine)
description: Guided squat that keeps constant quad tension through a deep range.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear foot elevated single-leg squat; brutal quad and glute builder that fixes imbalances.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Alternating forward lunges under load; strength plus balance for the whole lower body.

name: Leg Extension (Machine)
description: Machine knee extension isolating the quads; control the negative.

name: Step-Up
description: Drive up onto a knee-high box one leg at a time with dumbbells at your sides.

name: Leg Curl (Machine)
description: Lying or seated machine curl; the direct hamstring isolation.

name: Nordic Curl
description: Anchor the ankles and lower the torso under control; elite eccentric hamstring strength.

name: Good Morning (Barbell)
description: Barbell on the back, hinge at the hips with a near-straight torso; load lightly, hinge deep.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
description: GHD movement combining hip extension and knee flexion for the entire posterior chain.

name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
description: Shoulders on a bench, drive the bar up with the hips and squeeze hard at the top. The glute builder.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Floor hip bridge; the bodyweight regression of the hip thrust.

name: Cable Kickback
description: Kick one leg back against a low cable, squeezing the glute at full extension.

name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
description: Press the knees outward against the pads to hit the glute medius.

name: Sumo Deadlift (Barbell)
description: Wide-stance deadlift with a more upright torso; strong glute and inner-thigh emphasis.

name: Calf Raise (Standing)
description: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top; standing raises bias the gastrocnemius.

name: Calf Raise (Seated)
description: Seated raises with bent knees target the deeper soleus muscle.

name: Calf Press (Leg Press)
description: Press through the balls of the feet on the leg-press sled for heavy calf loading.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
description: One-leg raises off a step; add a dumbbell as you progress.

name: Plank
description: Rigid front support on forearms; brace everything and breathe. Time-based core strength.

name: Crunch
description: Curl the ribs toward the pelvis without pulling the neck; short range, full squeeze.

name: Cable Crunch
description: Kneeling rope crunch; the loadable, progressive ab exercise.

name: Ab Crunch (Machine)
description: Machine crunch with adjustable load; easy to track progressive overload.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from a bar and raise the legs (or knees) to horizontal without swinging.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: Roll out as far as you can hold a hollow position; scale range as you get stronger.

name: Russian Twist
description: Seated rotation with a weight, heels light; controlled anti-rotation core work.

name: Decline Crunch
description: Crunch on a decline bench; hold a plate on the chest to progress.

name: Wrist Curl
description: Forearm flexor curls over a bench for grip and forearm size.

name: Farmer's Carry
description: Walk tall with heavy dumbbells at your sides; grip, traps and core in one move.

name: Clean and Press
description: Explosive clean to the shoulders followed by an overhead press; full-body power.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Ballistic hip hinge swinging the bell to chest height; power endurance for the posterior chain.

name: Landmine Press
description: Press the landmine handle up and away at an angle; shoulder-friendly pressing.

name: Pullover (Dumbbell)
description: Lying across a bench, lower the dumbbell behind the head and pull it over the chest.

name: Pendlay Row (Barbell)
description: Strict row from a dead stop on the floor each rep; explosive mid-back strength.

name: Meadows Row
description: Landmine one-arm row with a wide elbow; unique lat and upper-back angle.

name: Chest-Supported Row (Dumbbell)
description: Row dumbbells while lying prone on an incline bench; zero momentum, all back.

name: Cable Row (Single-Arm)
description: Unilateral cable row with full stretch and rotation control.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
description: Machine-guided lateral raise; pure side-delt tension without cheating.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
description: Curl with the angled EZ bar; wrist-friendly heavy biceps work.

name: Spider Curl
description: Chest on an incline bench, arms hanging vertical; strict short-head focus.

name: JM Press
description: Hybrid of close-grip press and skullcrusher; a powerlifter's triceps builder.

name: Sissy Squat
description: Lean back and drop the knees forward over the toes; extreme quad stretch under control.

name: Adductor Machine
description: Squeeze the knees together against the pads to strengthen the inner thighs.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: Step backward into the lunge; knee-friendlier than forward lunges.

name: Seated Row (Machine)
description: Chest-supported machine row with a fixed arc; simple heavy back work.

name: Smith Machine Squat
description: Guided-bar squat; useful for controlled overload and safety without a spotter.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
description: Guided-bar bench press; push to failure safely with fixed bar path.

name: Incline Bench Press (Smith)
description: Guided incline press for upper-chest overload without a spotter.

name: Seated Overhead Press (Smith)
description: Guided seated shoulder press; strict delt loading with back support.

name: Back Extension (Machine)
description: Machine-loaded back extension for spinal erectors and glutes.

name: Ab Downs
description: Slow leg lowers from vertical while keeping the lower back pinned to the floor.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: Alternate driving the knees to the chest from a push-up position; core plus conditioning.

name: Side Plank
description: Rigid side support on one forearm; anti-lateral-flexion core strength.
